name: 1.19.0-desktop
body:
• FeedFlow has a fully redesigned interface that feels more at home on your desktop.
• The new Reader Mode engine is now the default. If an article doesn't look right, you can report it directly from the reader.
• Follow YouTube playlists and hide Shorts from channels.
• Feeds from sites that block requests load more reliably, with clearer error messages.
• Bookmarking an article now also saves its content.
• Marking articles above or below as read now respects your active filters.
• New option to use FeedFlow in English whatever your system language.
• Added a Day.Month date format.
• Podcast episodes show a banner to open them in your favorite player.

name: 1.18.0-desktop
body:
• Reader Mode has a brand-new engine that gives cleaner, more reliable articles. If a page doesn't look right, I'd love to hear your feedback.
• Adding a YouTube channel is easier: paste the channel link and FeedFlow finds its feed.
• FeedFlow now reopens maximized if you closed it that way.
• iCloud, Dropbox and Google Drive sync is much more reliable: pending edits, read states and category changes are no longer lost.
• Feeds and articles from sites that block requests now load more reliably.
• FeedFlow now tells you when you try to add a feed you already follow.
• The article list no longer jumps while articles are marked as read on scroll.

name: 1.17.0-desktop
body:
New Features:
• Try the experimental new Reader Mode engine for faster, more accurate article extraction. Help me improve it by reporting missing content or formatting issues.

Improvements:
• Improved Reader Mode image loading, embedded content, spacing, and support for short and image-only articles.
• Made bookmark actions and their current state clearer.

Bug Fixes:
• Fixed an issue that could prevent Dropbox from being unlinked.

name: 1.16.1-desktop
body:
New Features:
• Added global and per-feed controls for opening articles in Reader Mode, from feed content, or in a browser.
• Added an option to hide images for individual feeds.
• Added configurable background feed refresh with a new-article indicator.
• Added navigation to the next feed when the current feed is empty.

Improvements:
• Added confirmation before marking all articles above or below an item as read.
• Improved mixed-language text direction and article image detection.
• Improved keyboard focus when opening Reader Mode.

Bug Fixes:
• Fixed unread articles being skipped while scrolling.
• Fixed sync failures affecting some FreshRSS and Google Reader-compatible accounts.

name: 1.15.1-desktop
body:
• Choose big-image cards or a grid layout for your feeds.
• Reorder feeds and categories to match your workflow.
• Customize reader text with line height.
• Enjoy more reliable article loading with smarter feed refreshing.
• Improved reliability when opening web links.

name: 1.12.0-desktop
body:
New Features:
• Refreshed reader mode with an updated toolbar and navigation bar
• Move to the next feed source with a single tap.
• Delete all feeds in a category directly from the app.
• Customize the feed list: hide the unread dot, hide the feed source, or limit description lines.

Improvements:
• Cleaner, more focused settings screen.
• Refined desktop scroll bars.
• URL tooltip appears when hovering a link.
• Smoother animations when navigating between panes.
• Brand new app icon.

Bug Fixes:
• Fixed multiple startup and sync-related crashes.
• Fixed a crash when adding a category with an existing name.
• Better handling of invalid OPML and CSV imports.
• Fixed relative feed favicon URLs.
• Fixed 12-hour time formatting padding and other date issues.
• Various stability improvements.

name: 1.11.2-desktop
body: - Fix refresh menu not visually working

name: 1.11.1-desktop
body:
- Added a new three-pane desktop layout and a switch for users who prefer the single-pane view.
- Added a dedicated Settings window with sections for reading, feed list, accounts, sync storage, and about.
- Moved accounts, add feed, edit feed, import and export, and blocked words into separate desktop windows.
- Improved the docked sidebar with clearer icons, better contrast, stronger selection states, and refreshed colors.
- Improved Reader Mode with a new engine, cleaner navigation buttons, better spacing, and a clearer split between list and article panes.
- Improved desktop context menus and scrollbars.
- Expanded Feed Suggestions with a new Marketing category and more curated sources.
- Fixed Reader Mode so fast article switches no longer show stale content.

name: 1.10.0-desktop
body:
- Added Open Feed Website actions for faster source access.
- Improved reader mode rendering with some characters.
- Improved reader mode readability with better content width and spacing on large screens.
-  Fixed mark-all-above/below-as-read behavior with oldest-first sorting.
-  Fixed some bugs and possible crashes
- Fixed text scaling on HDPI screens on Linux

name: 1.9.0-desktop
body:
What's New:

  New Features:
  • Google Drive, Miniflux, Feedbin, and Bazqux sync integrations to connect with popular RSS services.
  • Drag and drop support to change feed categories directly from the sidebar.
  • OLED theme option for displays that support true black.
  • Mark all above/below as read feature for efficient article management.
  • Search filter chips to refine search results by Timeline, Read, or Bookmarks.
  • Platform-appropriate keyboard shortcuts (F5 for refresh, Cmd+Shift+A to mark all as read, and more).

  Improvements:
  • Desktop splash screen for better startup experience.
  • Enhanced menu structure with reorganized settings and options.
  • Improved favicon retrieval for feed sources.
  • Fixed various crashes and stability issues.
  • Improved reader mode rendering

name: 1.8.0-desktop
body:
What's New:

Offline Reading
  Articles can now automatically saved during feed synchronization, allowing you to read your content without an internet connection. 

Reader Mode Navigation
  Navigate between articles directly in reader mode using the new navigation toolbar. Move through your feed without interrupting
  your reading flow.

Cache Management
  New settings options allow you to clear article content and image cache, helping you manage storage space.

Improvements
  • Enhanced reader mode experience
  • Better content display and formatting
  • Streamlined navigation drawer interface
  • Improved date parsing for RSS feeds
  • Various performance improvements and bug fixes

name: 1.7.0-desktop
body:
- Added ability to open article comments directly from Reader Mode
- Prevents torrent files from opening in Reader Mode
- "Delete week-old posts" now respects current filter (Timeline, Category,
  Source)
- RSS items without links now use enclosure URLs (improves podcast feed support)
- Added confirmations for "mark all as read" and "delete week-old feeds" actions
- Fix some bugs on date handling
- Bug fixing and improvements

name: 1.6.0-desktop
body:

- Added the possibility to hide articles containing specific keywords/phrases
- Added quick-access button in sidebar to navigate to original feed websites
- Fixed a bug that prevented automatic favicon fetching
- Added visual warnings in the drawer and feed list for feeds that fail to fetch content
- Added possibility to delete feed sources directly from edit screen
- Added "Navigate to Feed Settings" option in article context menus
- Added error codes for better troubleshooting
- The app now remembers window position and size between sessions
- Added comprehensive tooltips to all reader mode controls
- Improved the dark/light mode detection
- Improved window theming
